# Backend dependency licence snapshot

Prepared by **Dhruba Poudel** on 2026-10-07.

These licence files were copied without changing their contents from the package distributions installed for prototype verification. This includes runtime and test dependencies, plus platform-specific dependencies. It is a notice snapshot, not a dependency lockfile or a claim that every future installation resolves to these versions. Retain the notices shipped with the versions you distribute, including embedded native-library notices, and refresh this inventory for releases.
